name: neov8
description: NeoV8 - a new operating system for the Voyetra Eight Rev4, with a browser front-panel simulator

scripts.dev: npm run gen && npm run roms && npm run fw && vite sim --open
scripts.build: npm run gen && vite build sim
scripts.test: npm run gen && npm run fw && vitest run
scripts.fw: node tools/gen-font.mjs && node tools/gen-ui-tables.mjs && node tools/gen-curves.mjs && make -C firmware
scripts.app: . tools/app/rust-env.sh && npm run fw && cargo run --release --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p v8-plugin --bin neov8 --
scripts.plugin: . tools/app/rust-env.sh && npm run fw && cd engine && cargo xtask bundle v8-plugin --release && mkdir -p ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 && rm -rf ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/NeoV8.clap ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/NeoV8.vst3 && cp -R target/bundled/NeoV8.clap ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/ && cp -R target/bundled/NeoV8.vst3 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ && echo 'NeoV8.clap and NeoV8.vst3 installed in ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins'
scripts.engine:test: . tools/app/rust-env.sh && cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.fw:stock: npm run roms && node tools/gen-font.mjs && node tools/gen-ui-tables.mjs && node tools/extract-tables.mjs && make -C firmware BUILD=build-stock DEFS="-D STOCK_TABLES"
